title.zh: Nasdaq Invests $100 Million in Kraken Parent Payward
title.en: Nasdaq Invests $100 Million in Kraken Parent Payward

current_state.zh: 纳斯达克风投已同意向Kraken母公司Payward拟投资1亿美元，后者计划在加密、股票、代币化股票、期货和期权等交易场所部署纳斯达克监控技术；该投资尚未完成，估值条款未披露，NET仍目标于2027年第二季度推出。
current_state.en: Nasdaq Ventures has agreed to a proposed $100 million investment in Kraken parent Payward, which plans to deploy Nasdaq surveillance across crypto, equities, tokenized equities, futures and options; the deal is not completed, valuation terms are undisclosed, and NETs remain targeted for Q2 2027.

updates.title_zh: Nasdaq deepens Kraken ties with proposed $100 million Payward investment
updates.title_en: Nasdaq deepens Kraken ties with proposed $100 million Payward investment
updates.what_changed_zh: 新信息澄清该1亿美元投资为拟议/已同意但未完成交易，未披露交割日期、估值、持股比例或治理权；并新增NET目标于2027年第二季度推出且代币尚未上线。
updates.what_changed_en: New facts clarify the $100 million investment is proposed/agreed but not completed, with no closing date, valuation, ownership percentage or governance rights disclosed; adds NET launch target of Q2 2027 and that tokens are not live.
updates.current_state_zh: 纳斯达克风投已同意向Kraken母公司Payward拟投资1亿美元，后者计划在加密、股票、代币化股票、期货和期权等交易场所部署纳斯达克监控技术；该投资尚未完成，估值条款未披露，NET仍目标于2027年第二季度推出。
updates.current_state_en: Nasdaq Ventures has agreed to a proposed $100 million investment in Kraken parent Payward, which plans to deploy Nasdaq surveillance across crypto, equities, tokenized equities, futures and options; the deal is not completed, valuation terms are undisclosed, and NETs remain targeted for Q2 2027.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Nasdaq Ventures agreed to invest $100 million in Kraken parent Payward, which will also deploy Nasdaq market-surveillance technology across its crypto, equities, tokenized equities, futures, and options venues as part of their tokenized-equity partnership.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Nasdaq Ventures agreed to invest $100 million in Kraken parent Payward, which will also deploy Nasdaq market-surveillance technology across its crypto, equities, tokenized equities, futures, and options venues as part of their tokenized-equity partnership.
